title: Detached / floating More overflow
cues: A More control floating at the far end of a tab/filter row, or a Decision More separated from the filled Pursue primary by a large gap / missing shared action cluster
ban: Overflow must share the Decision action cluster with the one filled primary (data-overflow=attached).
remediation: Place More immediately beside Pursue inside the same actions group; stamp data-overflow=attached. Filter extras use an attached toolbar control, not a naked floating More on the tab rail.
examples: SLED Capture: naked More text link on the All/Federal/State tab row with huge whitespace
Decision cell: Pursue then a distant ... More outside the action cluster
